description: This file defines the UsersViewDetail class, which extends ViewDetail and is responsible for rendering the detailed view of a user in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for pre-display setup, metadata retrieval, and rendering logic, along with incorporating user interface controls such as edit, duplicate, delete, and password management buttons.

classes.name: UsersViewDetail
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering detailed user views in SuiteCRM, including setup, display customization, and rendering functions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the UsersViewDetail class, calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares data and UI components before rendering the user detail view, including setting up buttons and permissions.

methods.name: getMetaDataFile
methods.description: Retrieves the metadata file path based on user type (regular, group).

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles the rendering of the user detail view, including panel visibility and reset preferences.

methods.name: getHelpText
methods.description: Returns HTML for help text and create link if the current user has admin privileges.
